name: weight-estimator
notes: Mask-area regression. Same YOLOv8-seg .pt as huddling-detector/0.2.0-seg can be used — segmentation training serves both purposes. Fit slope/intercept from (normalized_mask_area_px, weighed_weight_g) pairs via sklearn LinearRegression. Until model.pt + non-zero regression coefficients are provided, this version reports `available: false` in the dashboard and is unselectable.
